domain: Data-Heavy SaaS Dashboard / Air Quality Monitoring

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-bold

spacing_and_layout.general_philosophy: Generous spacing. p-6, p-8, or p-12 for containers. Containers with borders must have internal padding.
spacing_and_layout.grid_mode: Mode B: The 'Control Room' Grid (For Dashboards/Analytics)
spacing_and_layout.card_style: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Flat background (#111827), 1px solid border (#1E293B), no soft shadows. Sharp edges (rounded-none or max 4px).

components.buttons: Flat, solid colors for primary CTAs. Hover state must be lighter hue. Focus state needs ring-2 ring-blue-400.
components.cards: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts. Shadcn UI for interactive logic but stripped of Vercel-look (remove soft shadows, use sharp 1px borders).
components.charts: Shadcn chart components (Recharts). Use dark theme. Remove axis lines, use dotted grid lines (border-border). Status colors for data points based on AQI level.
components.navigation: Sticky Header with Crystal Glass (bg-[#0B1120]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#1E293B]). Must have visible links on desktop.
components.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboard layouts. Strict 24px or 20px sizes.
components.forms: Shadcn Form/Input/Select components heavily customized to match the technical grid border style.

hero_image.description: Aerial view of an urban industrial area with smokestacks during nighttime. Sets atmospheric context for Air Quality.

landing_background.description: Dramatic night view of cityscape with smokestacks emitting smoke against dark cloudy sky. Use with heavy bg-black/60 overlay.

partner_logo.description: Minimalist logo placeholder for PCB or partner references if needed.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. Example: hover:bg-[#1E293B] hover:text-white
motion_and_interaction.testing: MANDATORY data-testid attribute on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs).

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this file fully. All decisions must map back to these rules.
Follow 'Control Room' grid rules for both Student and PCB dashboards. Every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children.
Use 'Manrope' for all Headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Do NOT use Inter or Roboto.
Implement the 'Grid Borders' surface strategy. Expose the skeleton. Avoid heavy soft shadows. Rely on 1px sharp borders.
AQI Status Colors are critical. Display these prominently in KPI cards: Good (#10B981), Moderate (#F59E0B), Poor (#F97316), Severe (#EF4444).
Ensure the hero section on the landing page uses the provided image with an overlay of bg-[#0B1120]/60 max.
Do not use transparent headers without blur. Use crystal glassmorphism for the sticky nav.
Ensure robust data-testid attributes for testing across the entire app.
Avoid Inter/Roboto. Avoid purple/teal gradients. Stick to the deep stratosphere blue palette provided here.
